journey.title: Refine the search and choose the highlighted fruit with Enter
journey.goal: After the suggestions are refined, Enter selects the suggestion that is highlighted

functionalJourney.title: Choose a fruit with the pointer
functionalJourney.goal: Clicking a suggestion fills the fruit field

guards.title: Choose the second suggestion with arrow keys
guards.goal: ArrowDown twice and Enter selects the second suggestion

plan.root_cause: The navigation controller adds a keydown listener on each results refresh without removing the previous listener, causing stale listeners with outdated currentFocus values to remain active. After refining the search, the stale listener increments an outdated focus index, leading to the wrong suggestion being activated when Enter is pressed.
plan.repair_strategy: Ensure only one keydown listener is active at any time by detecting and removing any existing listener before adding a new one in the navigate function, storing the listener reference on the input field for proper cleanup.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard navigation of autocomplete suggestions will correctly reflect the current filtered list, allowing users to refine search and select the highlighted suggestion with Enter, satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 keyboard operability and 4.1.2 name-role-value.
functional_risks: If a custom navigation listener is provided via config.resultsList.navigation, the deduplication logic will still replace it, which could interfere with external libraries that expect to manage their own listeners.
Removing and re-adding listeners may cause a brief moment where no listener is attached if an event fires between removal and addition, though this window is extremely short.
Storing a private property (_autoCompleteNavListener) on the input field could theoretically conflict with other code using the same property name, but the risk is low.
verification_requirements: After focusing the combobox, typing 'b' should open the suggestion list.
Pressing ArrowDown twice should select the first suggestion (Blackberry) as indicated by aria-selected=true on #autoComplete_result_0.
Typing 'l' to refine to 'bl' should update the list to [Blackberry, Blackcurrant, Blueberry, Boysenberry] while keeping the first suggestion selected.
Pressing ArrowDown after refining should keep the first selection (still Blackberry) selected.
Pressing Enter should submit 'Blackberry' as the form value.
ESC should clear the input and close the suggestion list.
ArrowUp and ArrowDown should wrap correctly within the current suggestion list.

plan.root_cause: The navigation controller defines a local variable `navigate` that shadows the outer function, then references an undefined `navigateFn` variable. The keydown listener cleanup attempts to remove the outer `navigate` function instead of the actual listener, leaving stale listeners with outdated focus indices.
plan.repair_strategy: Rename the local navigation function reference to `navigateFn` to avoid shadowing, use it consistently for adding/removing listeners, and store it on the input field for proper cleanup when the suggestion list disappears.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard navigation of autocomplete suggestions will correctly reflect the current filtered list, allowing users to refine search and select the highlighted suggestion with Enter, satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 keyboard operability and 4.1.2 name-role-value.
functional_risks: If a custom navigation listener is provided via config.resultsList.navigation, the deduplication logic will still replace it, which could interfere with external libraries that expect to manage their own listeners.
Removing and re-adding listeners may cause a brief moment where no listener is attached if an event fires between removal and addition, though this window is extremely short.
Storing a private property (_autoCompleteNavListener) on the input field could theoretically conflict with other code using the same property name, but the risk is low.
